title: Factored
description: An automation-driven Minecraft modpack powered by Create.
body:
# Factored

Take to the stars and automate production across the cosmos in this industry-driven modpack built on Create and Cosmic Horizons. Not even the sky is the limit!

## Automation

Building on the foundation that Create provides, a large swath of mods are added on top to bring more automated crafting solutions, new resources to use, and quality of life improvements to keep your factories humming along! In addition to Create, ComputerCraft (CC: Tweaked) brings even more possibilities for automating whole interplanetary colonies!

## Expansion

World generation is enhanced with Terralith to bring more realistic and interesting biomes. Many vanilla structures are overhauled to make your exploration experience even better. The real expansion begins when you take to the stars via Cosmic Horizons, allowing you to leave Earth and build in space, on Mars, or anywhere else in the solar system. Establish ore factories on another planet, create highly-efficient farms in space, and more!
